slides.title: Tigray hospitals reopen, but big gaps remain
Medical supplies sent by WHO
slides.body: Supplies and health kits for Afar, Amhara and Tigray, according to OCHA.

slides.title: Hospitals working again
slides.body: Key facilities in Mekelle and Shire are among many Tigray hospitals that resumed services, OCHA said. More supplies are on the way.

slides.title: Fuel, funding and insecurity still limit aid
slides.body: Some flights and safe roads have reopened, OCHA said, but these gaps restrict how far help can reach.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Keep health care and aid open.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
